stem.en: What primarily causes a nuclear isomer's dramatically longer-than-usual lifetime?
stem.et: Mis põhjustab peamiselt tuumaisomeeri dramaatiliselt tavalisest pikema eluea?

label.en: A large mismatch in angular momentum (or nuclear shape) between the isomeric state and the state it must transition to, which strongly suppresses the gamma-decay pathway.
label.et: Suur impulsimomendi (või tuuma kuju) sobimatus isomeerse oleku ja oleku vahel, millesse see peab üle minema, mis surub tugevalt alla gammalagunemise raja.

label.en: Every excited nuclear state actually decays essentially instantly, so isomers with dramatically longer lifetimes don't really exist.
label.et: Iga ergastatud tuumaolek laguneb tegelikult sisuliselt koheselt, seega ei eksisteeri tegelikult dramaatiliselt pikema elueaga isomeere.

label.en: The isomer is a chemically distinct substance from the ground-state nucleus, so it simply follows different chemical decay rules.
label.et: Isomeer on põhiolekus olevast tuumast keemiliselt erinev aine, seega järgib see lihtsalt erinevaid keemilisi lagunemisreegleid.

label.en: The transition simply has an unusually small energy gap, the same way a small energy gap would slow down any ordinary physical process.
label.et: Üleminekul on lihtsalt ebatavaliselt väike energialõhe, samamoodi nagu väike energialõhe aeglustaks mistahes tavalist füüsikalist protsessi.
